name: Mirroring
description: Repeat the last 1-3 words to build rapport and encourage elaboration
when_use: Early to establish rapport and dig deeper into pain points

name: Empathy Response
description: Understand and articulate emotions to make them feel heard
when_use: When you want emotional bonding or to soften resistance

name: Empathy Questions
description: Acknowledge past efforts while opening discussion to improvements
when_use: When prospect justifies current solution and you want to guide them to better solution

name: Summarizing
description: Rephrase what they said in your own words
when_use: When you're not sure if you understand their viewpoint

name: Labeling
description: Name the emotions you observe to diffuse tension
when_use: When you feel tension building or negative emotions

name: Calibrated Questions
description: Ask open-ended 'how' or 'what' questions to shift control
when_use: When you want prospect to be more active in collaborating

name: Negative Assumption
description: Address potential objections upfront to disarm them
when_use: As soon as you suspect they have a concern or objection

name: Dynamic Silence
description: Use pauses to encourage them to fill silence with information
when_use: In later stages when you want prospect to tell more

name: Black Swan
description: Uncover hidden issues, problems, and desires
when_use: When progress stalls or they seem reluctant

name: Buy-In
description: Ask permission before engaging to make them teachable
when_use: When you want their focus or them to be open to new ideas

name: DJ Voice
description: Use deep, calm, slower voice when emotions rise
when_use: When emotions rise and fears are building

name: Truth with No
description: Ask questions answered with 'no' but meaning agreement
when_use: To discover truth or uncover real concerns

name: Take Away
description: Agree with objection and amplify it to remove pressure
when_use: When objections arise or emotions seem extraordinary
